required_actual_acceptance.commit_and_inputs: Bind the delivered commit, collector SHA, full source manifest/archive, canonical lock, command receipt and actual tool/environment identity. Keep dependency resolution evidence distinct from direct loaded-version observations.
required_actual_acceptance.methods: Require actual trace/outcome for each of KOL01,KOL02,KOL03,KOL04,KOL05,KOL06,KOL07,KOL08-GRACEFUL,KOL09-KILL; no skip, missing method, setup error or cleanup failure counts as pass. Report full ordinary-suite status separately from these nine outcomes.

artifacts.failure_semantics: Missing/partial records preserve actual failure; JSON cleanup alone does not replace method assertions or full trace.

required_actual_acceptance.KOL09: Retain exact fault_reason, explicit raw reply distinct from public denial, pointer/resource timing, old-resource ordering and cleanup. If an assertion fails, preserve its actual record and failure; do not remove or weaken assertions to obtain green. JSON cleanup alone does not prove test-body success.
required_actual_acceptance.earlier_failures: If format/compile/release/fixture setup prevents tests, report unrun or partial methods and missing artifacts. Existing upload if-no-files-found:ignore is retention behavior, not qualification.
